description: Return exact-symbol consumers, transitive affected files, and targeted tests for a TypeScript export or exported class method. Select either export_name, or both class_name and member_name. The result is advisory project-impact evidence and does not duplicate tsc or Oxlint diagnostics.

allow_remote_extends.description:
Allow trusted HTTPS config `extends` for this request. Defaults to false
and never grants process-global trust.

class_name.description: Exact exported class name. Must be paired with `member_name`.

config.description: Path to a fallow config file.

export_name.description:
Exact exported symbol name. Mutually exclusive with the class-method
selector.

member_name.description: Exact method name. Must be paired with `class_name`.

root.description: Project root; defaults to the working directory.

threads.description: Parser thread count; defaults to CPU cores.

type_aware_projects.description: Explicit tsconfig paths. Project auto-discovery is used when omitted.

type_aware_require.description: Whether incomplete semantic evidence is advisory or gating.

name: symbol_impact
